description: Retrospective. All-time bests per exercise, computed on the fly with no table: weighted tracks estimated 1RM (Epley), heaviest, and best volume; reps tracks most reps; time tracks longest hold; distance tracks furthest, scored in metres so units compare. A live PR banner and badge at log time, PR tags in the session recap, and a Records card on Trends. Warm-up sets are filtered out of every calculation.
title: Personal records and new-PR moments
